method: Each of the 332 released hybrid questions sent once, unchanged (marked_query, the required term in double quotes), to POST https://scholar.thedreamlabinnovations.com/v1/corpus/search with mode semantic and topK 50; at most 3 requests a second and 4 in flight; 429/502/503/504 retried after Retry-After. Scored as the released hybrid-332 figures: rank of the target (DOI or PubMed ID) in the top 50; a refusal or error is a miss; denominator 332.
